title: Keep stepped activity animations aligned after keyed DOM moves
outcome: Moving an already tracked visible activity indicator within the app preserves common step-phase alignment without per-frame JavaScript.
acceptance: A behavioral reorder case moves an already tracked indicator or its ancestor and verifies its recreated activity animation aligns with the existing indicators.
Dynamic additions, removals, visibility changes and teardown retain their current behavior; no per-frame timer or animation-frame loop is introduced.
